items.title: Tor amplitude can be checked on the stalks when the site has enough points, and always passes to stalks
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that tor amplitude passes to stalks and, when the site has enough points, can be checked there (statement lines 12689-12700). The proof (proof lines 12702-12716) reads the stalk as a pullback along a morphism of ringed sites for the first part and uses the stalk criterion for exactness, together with the compatibility of tensor products with stalks, for the second. H2: two short arguments.
